component.name: Seeparah
component.summary: Free classics and sacred texts, with offline reading

description.p: Seeparah is a free multilingual reading app. Search the published Seeparah catalogue of public-domain literature and source-verified sacred texts, read them in their available original languages, and save editions for offline reading.
Highlights, notes, bookmarks, reading progress and page-local ink are stored on your device. No account, subscription or purchase is needed to read.
